plugins.name: cartoony-ui
plugins.description: Cartoony Roblox UI style: chunky layered strokes, offset underlays, gradient rarity cards, outlined titles, bouncy motion. Use when asked for cartoony, cartoon, simulator-style, kid-friendly or "Pet Sim style" Roblox UI.

plugins.name: horror-ui
plugins.description: Horror Roblox UI and atmosphere: muted, diegetic, low-clutter menus and HUDs plus horror environment boards. Use when asked for horror, scary, creepy or Doors/Forsaken-style Roblox UI.

plugins.name: roblox-ui
plugins.description: Roblox UI/GUI reference: top-game UI studies, HUDs, shops, inventories, popups, responsive layout, Figma-to-Studio handoff and Luau UI code. Use for any Roblox UI design or implementation task.

plugins.name: roblox-top-games
plugins.description: Profiles and teardowns of the most-played Roblox games (loops, UI, art, monetization). Use when the user names a top Roblox game or wants to copy proven patterns.

plugins.name: roblox-game-design
plugins.description: Roblox game design: virality, core loops, retention, monetization, onboarding, thumbnails, live ops, level design and economy. Use when planning or reviewing a Roblox game concept or system design.

plugins.name: roblox-3d-models
plugins.description: Roblox 3D art: fidelity tiers, art styles, Blender modeling, stylised and voxel modelling, materials, lighting and model reference boards. Use for any Roblox modeling, asset or environment-art task.

plugins.name: roblox-animation
plugins.description: Roblox animation: locomotion, combat, emotes, Moon Animator, Blender, cutscenes, cameras and Animator code. Use for any Roblox character, camera or cutscene animation task.

plugins.name: roblox-audio
plugins.description: Roblox SFX and audio: satisfying sounds, UI and combat SFX, ambience, music rules and the Audio API. Use for any Roblox sound design or audio code task.

plugins.name: roblox-vfx
plugins.description: Roblox VFX and lighting: particles, beams, trails, ability and reward effects, weather, flipbooks and stylised lighting. Use for any Roblox visual-effect or lighting task.

plugins.name: roblox-coding
plugins.description: Roblox Luau engineering: architecture, data saving, remotes, anti-exploit, performance, genre systems, physics and an API atlas. Use when writing, reviewing or debugging Roblox Luau code.

plugins.name: voxel-models
plugins.description: Voxel and blocky "brainrot" Roblox models: voxel, Part-built and low-poly flat styles, palettes, stud scale, greedy meshing, a Blender voxel-to-GLB script, plus brainrot game teardowns and their UI kit. Use when asked for voxel, voxelated, blocky, stud-style, "slop" or Steal a Brainrot-style models.
